name: HV1 (mtDNA)
description: Mitochondrial haplogroup HV1 is a Near Eastern and Mediterranean branch of the HV clade, found at notable frequencies in the Arabian Peninsula, the Levant, and the Mediterranean basin. HV1 is particularly prevalent among Arab populations of the Arabian Peninsula (5–12%) and reaches moderate frequencies in North Africa, the Levant, and Turkey. It appears to be one of the pre-Neolithic maternal lineages of the Near East that expanded in the region before and during the Holocene. HV1's distribution across the Mediterranean and Arabian Peninsula reflects both ancient Near Eastern populations and subsequent expansions along historic trade and migration routes.
interestingFact: Haplogroup HV1 is found at particularly high frequencies among Bedouin Arab populations of the Arabian Peninsula, suggesting it may have been a defining lineage of early Arabian pastoralist communities that expanded across the region as populations adapted to arid environments during the Holocene.
